workload.profile: deterministic in-process MCP fixture; no network or model calls

selectedToolPayloadLowerBound.note: Hypothetical host-side one-tool catalog selection; MCP tools/list has no standard per-tool filter, so this is a payload lower bound.

tokenProxy.method: serialized JSON bytes divided by four, rounded up
tokenProxy.limitation: Byte-based rough proxy only; excludes transport framing and model tokenization, and does not estimate all prompt/context reuse behavior.

limitations: Cold latency includes server/client fixture construction, in-memory connection, and the first workflow call; warm latency reuses connected sessions. Both exclude host model planning, real MCP processes, network latency, and embedding model initialization.
The discovery engine is seeded to return the correct fixture result; search relevance and misses are not benchmarked.
NCP uses its real MCPServer tools/list/tools/call handlers and NCPOrchestrator find/run methods, with a controlled downstream connection result.
The selected-tool row is an explicitly hypothetical selective catalog payload, not an MCP protocol feature.
The result is deterministic correctness evidence and a reproducibility harness, not a claim about production host performance.
